approved_main_model.role: primary reasoning model for formal validation (A0-A5) and the later authorized sealed holdback
approved_main_model.grounding: goal12-output/cleanroom/docs/freeze-v1/omni-context-evaluation-freeze-v1.json models.answer = deepseek-v4-flash (previous experiment system); desktop-daemon/src/lib/llm-presets.ts deepseek recommendedModels includes deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
approved_main_model.runtime_identity_rule: the actual model identity/version returned by the API MUST be recorded before/at formal run; if the returned identity differs from the frozen config, the run is invalid per invalid-run-policy.md (MODEL_IDENTITY_MISMATCH); silent model substitution is forbidden

auxiliary_evaluator.role: auxiliary evaluation model ONLY for protocol parts that genuinely require an LLM evaluator
constraints: must NOT be upgraded to a second A0-A5 main-experiment model without a new owner approval
must NOT be used to select the better model
auxiliary budget is reserved (¥20) but actual usage must be recorded per non-core/auxiliary evaluation
if the frozen protocol does not need Kimi 2.6 (scorer v1.1 is fully deterministic), it must NOT be called just to consume budget

rules: no automatic overspend; any projected exceedance of ¥220 stops the run BEFORE further calls and is reported to the owner
validation and holdback budgets are estimated and recorded separately (see budget_estimates)
re-running or topping up requires a new owner approval; never run first and top up after

validation.formula: samples x arms x attempts x tokens_per_call x price_per_token (est. per-call tokens TBD at provider confirmation)
validation.note: estimate must be finalized from provider pricing BEFORE the validation run; if validation + holdback estimates exceed ¥220, stop and report the gap

holdback.formula: samples x arms x attempts x tokens_per_call x price_per_token
holdback.note: single sealed pass; estimate finalized before the holdback ceremony; must fit within the ¥220 total cap

budget_estimates.per_call_price_status: TBD - provider pricing confirmation required before any formal call; no spend has occurred

scope: frozen prompt/context required for the formal experiment
nothing containing real user privacy data
prohibited: real medical, financial or other sensitive personal records
project-private data unrelated to this benchmark
holdback custody secrets, seed, decryption material, or authorization keys
remote_data_processing.holdback_rule: when the holdback is later executed under a formal two-person ceremony, ONLY the benchmark sample content necessary for model inference may be sent; custody/seal secrets must never be sent

run_time_window.rule: do not compromise experiment integrity to wait for evening; do not terminate a legitimate run because it crosses daytime

owner.note: owner identity fields are intentionally not filled: no name/signature/organization was provided and none may be fabricated

signature.note: the project owner has no cryptographic signing mechanism in place; per owner instruction the explicit owner-decision record and timestamp stand as the approval; no signature is forged

acceptance_criteria_met: one main model identity for A0-A5 (deepseek-v4-flash)
temperature 0, fixed max_output_tokens, retry 3 transport/parse only
model identity recorded per response; mismatch invalidates the run
budget caps: DeepSeek ¥200, Kimi ¥20, total hard cap ¥220
remote synthetic benchmark processing approved with restrictions
preferred night execution window with unrestricted start when operationally preferable
next_steps: record provider pricing and finalize validation/holdback estimates within ¥220 before any formal call
seal per-split authorization files (formal-run-authorization-template.json) at run time
